newsitem.title: NEPAL: German president arrives on rare Nepal visit.
newsitem.headline: German president arrives on rare Nepal visit.

text.p: German President Roman Herzog arrived in Kathmandu on Monday as the first foreign head of state to visit Nepal since a multi-party democracy was established six years ago, the Foreign Ministry said.
King Birendra and Queen Aishwarya were at the airport to greet him.
Herzog arrived for a six-day stay in the Himalayan kingdom after completing a state visit to China. He is the first German president to visit Nepal in 29 years.
He is scheduled to hold talks with Prime Minister Sher Bahadur Deuba and tour the picturesque town of Pokhara.

Germany is one of Nepal's leading aid donors, supplying $28 million in annual grants. One of the world's 10 poorest countries, Nepal depends on foreign aid to fund more than 60 percent of its economic development.
